description.narrative: TM2 will address quality deficits and improve the level of service in a key road corridor in Colombia, resulting in travel time savings and improved safety. Furthermore, the Project will also help in increasing integration by enabling the completion of a corridor that improves connectivity between Colombia's central and northern regions, providing a more efficient route to connect with the major gateway ports in Barranquilla and Cartagena. The Project is also expected to have a positive impact in terms of direct and indirect job creation

The proposed investment entails an A-Loan of up to US$135 million -Loan in COP-linked equivalent for the financing of the Barrancabermeja San Roque concession (TM2 or the Project). The Project is a brownfield toll road awarded in 2022 by the Colombias National Infrastructure Agency (ANI) through a competitive bidding process. The concession scope includes design, construction, rehabilitation, expansion, and O&M activities for up to 25 years. TM2 has a length of 272km. Construction activities include 192km of second lanes and urban exchanges and the rehabilitation of 80km.
